ns2:course.label: Actuarial Theory II
ns2:course.description: Continuation of MATH 471. Emphasis is on multiple-life functions. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 or 4 graduate hours. 4 hours of credit requires approval of the instructor and completion of additional work of substance. Prerequisite: MATH 471.
